context: Evaluates correct usage of the SpatialGrid class from @pascal-app/core. The candidate must instantiate SpatialGrid with a cellSize configuration, use insert/remove/update to manage items, call canPlace with position/dimensions/rotation to check for collisions, and use queryRadius to find nearby items.

checklist.name: SpatialGrid instantiation
checklist.description: Instantiates SpatialGrid with a { cellSize } configuration object (e.g., new SpatialGrid({ cellSize: 0.5 })).

checklist.name: insert usage
checklist.description: Calls grid.insert(itemId, position, dimensions, rotation) with correct [x,y,z] tuple arguments to register an item, verifiable via getItemCount().

checklist.name: remove usage
checklist.description: Calls grid.remove(itemId) to deregister an item; getItemCount() decreases accordingly.

checklist.name: canPlace usage
checklist.description: Calls grid.canPlace(position, dimensions, rotation, ignoreIds?) and correctly reads the { valid, conflictIds } result to detect overlaps.

checklist.name: queryRadius usage
checklist.description: Calls grid.queryRadius(x, z, radius) and uses the returned array of item IDs for spatial lookups.
